queue.name: Backlit Haze Beam
queue.prompt: Relight this image. Change nothing else except the lighting and the addition of atmospheric haze. A hard backlight sits behind the subject and slightly camera-right, aimed toward the lens, so a visible beam of light cuts through fine airborne haze and separates the subject from a dark background. The haze is thin and even, densest where the beam is brightest, thinning toward the frame edges. Front fill is minimal, leaving the face in soft shadow with a bright rim along the hair and shoulders. Neutral white light, realistic falloff, subtle film grain. Keep the subject's identity, pose, expression, hairstyle, clothing and the framing exactly as they are.
